props.name: name
props.description: Full name. Drives the avatar initials and the heading.

props.name: role
props.description: Job title, team or handle, under the name.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Portrait URL. Without one the avatar shows initials.

props.name: coverSrc
props.description: Banner image URL across the top of the full card. Omitted, a soft accent band is drawn instead.

props.name: bio
props.description: A sentence or two about the person. Full variant only.

props.name: stats
props.description: Counts in a row under the bio — posts, followers, projects. Full variant only.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The main action — Follow, Message. Usually a Button.

props.name: variant
props.description: full is the standalone card with cover, bio and stats; compact is a single row for lists.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the name, so the card fits the page outline.
